description: Android Portal 2 client: the Portal profile's SDL3 app shell, pins and native Vulkan renderer with the portal2 game target, packaged by build-android-portal2-apk.sh.

intent.support_scope: Android build and packaging slice for the separate Portal 2 target. Not platform acceptance: nothing about the Portal profile's device evidence carries over.
intent.packaging: APK from the Portal profile's pinned SDK build-tools; licensed retail Portal 2 content (VPKs, loose maps and materials) is staged from a Steam installation and pushed separately to the app-specific external files directory

content.staging: tools/quality/stage_portal2_runtime.py --mount-custom: the retail search-path order spelled out in portal2/gameinfo.txt, plus <game>/custom/* for the APK's touch icons

known_blockers: Everything in the Portal profile's known_blockers (BC textures, surface teardown)
Retail Portal 2 content is about 11.5 GB on the device
